items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs Lions as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade talks finalized; team informed morning of game.
items.implication: Zero fantasy value Week 5; targets shift to remaining AZ WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Michael Wilson and Kendrick Bourne.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week, week-to-week.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee with Shipley/Pierce; major downgrade to PHI run game.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down work to remaining backs and pass-catchers.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; major hit to BAL offense and Flowers/Andrews upside.
items.opportunity: Checkdown/volume bump possible for RBs and TEs if game script allows.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty listed QUESTIONABLE; Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Ankle/foot; DNP Friday after limited Thursday.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT, backup takes lead role.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full backfield opportunity for elevated backup.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has only 5 catches in 4 games; wasn't a real factor even before inactive/trade. Bracing for Kia Kendrick Bourne szn.
items.implication: Confirms limited prior impact; boosts Wilson/Bourne.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: PHI WR depth thin with Brown also OUT; Goedert return helps.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: Jets RB committee continues without lead back.

items.text: Stefon Diggs listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: WAS WR room thins; McLaurin Q status key.
items.opportunity: Target share to McLaurin/Deebo if active.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (not on final report).
items.why: Ankle maintenance but cleared final report.
items.implication: Expected larger role after Week 4 criticism.

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert listed IN.
items.implication: WAS/NO/PHI offenses get key pieces back.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage criticism. Not on final IR.
items.why: Fan/media drag on Week 4 usage may prompt more work; cleared report.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside if role expands.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, red-zone share expansion expected.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle limits or committee persists.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins (WR8 @TEN volume/RZ), Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @WSH), Chase Brown (RB5 @MIA workload/matchup).
items.why: Target hogs + soft matchups/defenses weak vs position; Brown gobbles targets.
items.implication: Start with confidence; high floor/ceiling spots.
items.opportunity: Volume and red-zone usage drive rankings.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41 @NO injury/matchup), Mark Andrews (TE17 @ATL), Cam Skattebo (RB20 @WSH), Tony Pollard (RB28 vs HOU), Jalen Hurts (QB15 vs JAX London banged-up line/rough stretch).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency concerns, injury wrinkles, game environment.
items.implication: Fade/sit in most formats this week.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk stack long-term: knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Short-term still good play.
items.why: Sore knee + frustration over targets + stacked injury/QB/coaching risks.
items.implication: Monitor closely; ROS caution despite elite talent.
